- The genus name "Allopseudaxine" has a structure typical of monogenean flatworms (gill parasites of fish). Related-sounding genera like *Pseudaxine* are monogeneans in the family Gastrocotylidae, which parasitize the gills of marine fishes, particularly scombrids (tunas and mackerels).
